reply.observation: The robot held the pink flower over the card. The person took it and pressed it onto the end of the drawn stem.
reply.interpretation: They may have wanted help bringing the flower over while keeping the final placement in their hands.
reply.title: Offer the flower for final placement
reply.note: On a similar card, bring the flower within reach and let the person place it if they reach for it. This may have been specific to this card.
